content: Ne zutun midlaus medhipanew ensi Abraham ne midhendiyè dan te tanà he Negev. Ne ziyè dan med-ubpà te pid-elangan te inged he Kadesh wey Shur. Ne hein neuǥet midhalin si Abraham diyà te inged he Gerar.
Hein dutun dan en, ne migkeǥiyan din is menge etew he etevey zin si Sara. Umbe impaangey ni Hadì Abimelec he hadì te Gerar si Sara su ed-esewaan din.
Sevaha zutun he mezukilem, mibpeteǥeinep is Nengazen ki Abimelec he egkaǥi te, “Ebpengelinteuwan ku he mebpatey ka, su haazà is bahi he migkuwa nu, duen din en esawa.”
Piru wazè pa uvayi ni Abimelec si Sara, ne tenged dutun migkaǥi sikandin te, “Nengazen, maan is edhimetayan nu is menge etew ku? Wazà a mekesalà?
Migkeǥiyan a ni Abraham he etevey zin si Sara, ne si Sara zaan migkeǥiyan e zin he meemahan din si Abraham. Angin ke netuenan ku he esawa zin su wazè ku pezem kuwaa si Sara, iyan, wazè ku metueni.”
Midtavak is Nengazen te, “Uya, netuenan ku he wazà mezaat he tuyù nu kandin, umbe mibpengelinteuwan ku he kenè ka mekeuvey kandin, su wey ka kenà mekesalà kedì.

Kinahanglan he ilikù nu sikandin diyà te ki Abraham, su ebpeneuven sikandin, ne id-ampù ke zin su wey ka kenà mebpatey. Piru emun kenè nu id-ulì, ebpetizeenan ku sikew he kenè en ebperis ne ebpatey ke en iyan ragkes is langun he menge sakup nu.”
Ne hein nepawà dutun te sunud he andew, mid-umew ni Abimelec is langun he menge upisyal zin, ne midtudtulan din sikandan mehitenged te teǥeinep din. Ne utew sikandan nahandek.

Ne zutun mid-umew ni Abimelec si Abraham ne mid-insaan din te, “Hengkey ves heini is mid-ulaula nu kenami? Hengkey is salè ku kenikew he iyan inhimuwa nu he mekesalà a wey is tivuuk he ginhedian ku? Kenà hustu heini is mid-ulaula nu.”
Ne ke sikandin en maan diyà te ki Abraham te, “Hengkey is tuyù nu kayi te mid-ulaula nu?”

Midtavak si Abraham te, “Mid-ulaula ku heini, su neisip ku is kela ke wazà minsan sevaha kayi he edtahud te Megbevayà, umbe neisip ku is iring kayi su kela ke himetayi a keniyu ne egkuwaan niw is esawa ku.
Tutuu iyan he etevey ku si Sara, su anak te amey ku, piru selakew is iney zin, ne mid-esawa ku.

Hein migkeǥiyan a te Nengazen he med-awà a ziyà te inged te amey ku, migkeǥiyan ku si Sara he ipekilala zin he telesuled key minsan hendei key mekepevayà. Pinaaǥi kayi igkepeehè din is dekelà he gaǥew zin kedì.”
Ne zutun in-ulì ni Abimelec si Sara ziyà te ki Abraham, ne mibeǥayan din si Abraham te menge kerehidu, baka, wey menge uripen he maama wey vahi.
Ne migkeǥiyan ni Abimelec si Abraham te, “Andam a te kebpeubpà keniyu kayi te tanè ku, ne iyan ka pilì ke hendei ka egkesuat he ed-ubpà.”

Ne migkeǥiyan din si Sara te, “1,000 he vuuk he pelata is ibeǥey ku ziyà te meemahan nu. Iyan heini ibpayùpayù ku keniyu su wey metueni te langun he menge zuma niw he wazà a mekesalà wey wazè ka mekepehilavet kedì.”

Tenged te kegkuwaa ni Abimelec ki Sara, mibpengelinteuwan te Megbevayà he kenà mekaanak is langun he menge vahi zutun te valey zin. Umbe mid-ampù si Abraham diyà te Megbevayà, ne mibpengelinteuwan te Megbevayà he meulii si Abimelec te zaru zin wey is esawa zin wey is menge uripen din he vahi su wey zan mekeuman mekaanak.
